import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
    "score": [95.5, 87.3, 92.1, 88.9, 91.2]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the binary data
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nSerialized size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from the binary buffer
buffer_read = BytesIO(parquet_bytes)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer_read)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Confirm round trip
print("\nRound trip successful:", df.frame_equal(df_restored))

```python
import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eve"],
    "score": [95.5, 87.3, 92.1, 88.9, 91.2]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the binary data
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nSerialized size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from the binary buffer
buffer_read = BytesIO(parquet_bytes)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer_read)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Confirm round trip
print("\nRound trip successful:", df.frame_equal(df_restored))
```
